ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It says who fixes this round and how the re-review runs.

ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md` around line 12 to confirm that `--dry_run` is the only wrong name and that nothing else in the file needs a change.

ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md:12`. Change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`. F1 is a wrong name in prose, in one file, so the skill lets me make this fix myself. No code or test reads this file, so the fix changes no behavior.

ACTION: Commit the change to `docs/sync.md` on the task branch, with a message that names F1.

ACTION: Append a note to the implementer's report file in `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/`. The note says what I changed, that it changes no behavior, and that no test covers it.

ACTION: Run `<this-skill-dir>/scripts/review-package specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md <base> <head>` for the fix commit, using the BASE rule in `references/file-handoffs.md`. The diff file is the input for the re-review.

ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review with model `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The diff is small and mechanical, so `sonnet` is enough. The prompt contains F1 verbatim, the diff file path, the plan's global constraints, and no opinion on severity. The reviewer reports ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED for F1 and any new Critical or Important issue.

Task 3 review found one Important issue. `docs/sync.md:12` names the flag `--dry_run`, but the code, the help text and the tests use `--dry-run`.

I am fixing that one word myself. It is a docs-only change and it changes no behavior. A scoped re-review will check it. I will mark Task 3 complete in the ledger only after that re-review is clean.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- argparse turns `--dry-run` into the attribute `args.dry_run`. That is why the underscore form looks right in code and wrong on the command line.
- Docs that no test reads can drift from the code without any failure. The review caught this drift. A test would not have.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
